$comment: The consuming repo's closed lanes, as CLAUDE.md sections 3 and 4 describe them. Supplying this to `mfc lint` turns 'the geometric lane is closed' from a paragraph into a build failure.
$comment_allowlist: I-06, and the inversion of the denylist below. A denylist over Mathlib is unbounded -- a module its author never heard of is permitted by default, and every Mathlib release enlarges the set that silently passes. This bounds it: anything not named here is refused, including modules that did not exist when the list was written. The topic's own root is permitted implicitly and is deliberately not listed.

closed_lanes.name: geometry
closed_lanes.note: D^b(Coh X), Serre duality, Chern characters, HRR, numerical Grothendieck groups of varieties, SODs, Fourier-Mukai. None exist in Mathlib at the pinned commit. A reachable prefix here means someone started the multi-year program by accident.
